title: Transfer Learning for Hate Speech Detection in Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to classify 'Sexist' tweets and diagnosing misclassifications (e.g., false positives containing 'I am not sexist, but...') using a t-SNE visualization space ('Map of Hate') and word-level highlighting derived from max-pooling layer activations.

Evaluating the model's ability to classify 'Racist' tweets and using 2D embedding visualizations to uncover underlying dataset sampling biases, specifically noting how the racist labels heavily clustered around Islamophobic terminology.

Using transfer learning to jointly train models on multiple independent datasets, effectively measuring whether combining diverse human annotator perspectives and labeling criteria can mitigate the subjectivity, implicit biases, and specific sampling flaws present in a single dataset.
